oracle: Human-authored expected facts, quotes and query answers; no product extractor, resolver or model outputs used as gold. Canonical SourceMessage content_hash and normalization helpers are allowed for replay-input identity; recorded extraction/build_documents helpers enumerate embedding input hashes only and never alter expected answers.
recorded_response_kind: manually authored test double; not a capture of a real LLM response
source_sha256_definition: SourceMessage.content_hash: SHA-256 of full trusted normalized envelope encoded as canonical UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)
split_policy: Development source projects ProjectOrion/MarketMesh; holdout source/query project TaskHarbor only. Shared rule families and canonical field names remain; not a claim of template independence.
expected_fact_policy: effective_at always explicit in gold; selected recorded candidate effective_at null exercises observed_at default; all correct targets are stable seed IDs
query_policy: All cases in a split are ingested together before scoring queries. known_at restricts observation. Gold source IDs are deduplicated sets; unknown answers cite no sources.
product_id_policy: Synthetic gold event IDs are independent of product NLP IDs; compare complete fact fields and source_id, not equality of generated event IDs.
recorded_vector_policy: Hand-authored ideal predicate one-hot vectors use gold query keys only during fixture authoring; pipeline contract replay only, never real model or semantic quality. Gold and actual document hashes and observation snapshots are included.
